title: Oscillatory replacement

results_spent: D/D'/D5 cross-volume obstruction on rank-at-most-one cuts

partner.application: For Q_k=2k(H1Y1+H2Y2)+2H1U+2H2V+2k^-2 UV, k>=2, det(BB^T)=k^4 and c=k^-2, so ||p_Qk||_inf<=3; Weyl leaves four eigenvalues of modulus >1.

new_results.statement: Any literal physical edge A_ij=mu!=0 in an arbitrary ambient quadratic form gives H_1/4(Q)<=3.179662567631707 |mu|^-1/4, by conditional Plancherel plus the required fractional-potential theorem.
If one endpoint of a literal edge has zero diagonal, H_1/2(Q)<=4 sqrt(2)|mu|^-1/2, with arbitrary remaining curvature, by two cap-one rearrangement steps.
After a literal scalar pivot a!=0, if the Schur complement contains a zero-diagonal edge mu!=0, then ||p_Q||_inf<=4 sqrt(2)|a mu|^-1/2.

target_family.volume_obstruction: Every disjoint cross block in n=3 has rank at most one, so Z3=Z5=0.

counterexample_to_stronger_interface.statement: A nonzero physical edge does not imply finite H_1/2: for independent centered unit-interval X,Y, R=(X+Y)^2 has E|R|^-1/2=E|X+Y|^-1=infinity.

next_step: Force a third product-preserving resource from the three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis in the generic-edge/rank-one-arrowhead state and combine it with the universal quarter-potential before paying a vanishing coefficient.
